option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific type and presentation of paraganglioma, which is a broader category that includes SDHB-related paraganglioma.
Hereditary paraganglioma–pheochromocytoma syndrome (SDHB mutation) is the underlying genetic condition that causes SDHB-related paraganglioma. The leaf is a manifestation of this syndrome.
Malignant paraganglioma (metastatic or multifocal) describes a characteristic of paraganglioma, which can include SDHB-related paraganglioma.
The option 'Paraganglioma (SDHB-related)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Paraganglioma, SDHB-related'.
